Context: Medical claims requiring opinion of specialists

a separate referral (permission) letter from the CGHS.  
The medical prescription issued by a CGHS Medical Officer/ Government Specialist prescribing diagnostic tests/ investigations is valid for a single use within a period of two weeks from the date of prescription unless specifically provided otherwise by them in the prescription. OMs, dated 1-1-2013 and 15-1-2013.
